notes.title: Cyberstorm Arrives – The Last Big Update!
notes.notes:
A bittersweet moment—after a long solo journey of developing this RTS game, from programming to design and testing (with a little help from my kids), Nuke Them All is now fully complete. The final update is live!

Thank you to everyone who supported this adventure. While the game didn’t get as much exposure as I hoped, those who played it gave amazing feedback, and I truly appreciate it.

What’s New in the Final Update?
🔹 New Bonus Level – Cyberstorm!
Find it in the Volcano World by clicking the Cyberstorm planet image above the "Sandbox" button. This new map brings fast-paced strategy and action—hope you enjoy it!

Thank you for being part of this journey.

Papa Mike
Solo Developer

notes.title: 🎃 Zombiepocalypse Strikes in Our Massive Halloween Update! 🎃
notes.notes:
Commanders, the ultimate challenge has arrived with the new Halloween update, bringing fresh gameplay elements, new units, and major improvements to our indie RTS game! The game is now finely tuned, with hours of bug-free and crash-free gameplay as seen in recent streams. We're almost at the finish line for full release, but we're still working hard to get it running smoothly on the Steam Deck – stay tuned for more updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148300/fd74d11520751ad366f578bb8174fd1d88824b04.png

🧟 New Units to Watch Out For:

Zombie Archer Boss: The headless rider of nightmares! This new boss pairs perfectly with the Zombie Boss and makes its terrifying appearance at night. Armed with deadly fire arrows and riding a massive zombie horse, you'll want to steer clear when he’s on the prowl!
EggBot: The enemy’s new powerhouse! An incredibly fast and agile bot, equipped with laser eyes and a deadly stun grenade to take down your forces in the blink of an eye!

🎮 New Gameplay Elements & Controls:

CTRL + Z: Quickly select all your factories to set new rally points with ease.
"R" Key Functionality: Select your damaged vehicles and tanks, press "R," and they'll automatically retreat to the repair bay and return to the battle once fully restored.

🏚️ Haunted House Map: Experience the featured spooky map – Haunted House, crafted specifically for Scream Steam Fest & Halloween, complete with a new boss to haunt your nightmares!

🛠️ Optimizations & Fixes: Our Halloween update also comes with further optimizations and bug fixes to ensure smooth gameplay. Plus, the demo is fully updated, including all the latest features and elements for you to enjoy!

⚔️ An RTS Classic with a Modern Twist: Race against the clock, capture flags, conquer territories, and obliterate the enemy fort. And when it's all over – nuke them into oblivion! This old-school, sci-fi real-time strategy game, lovingly crafted by our dedicated team, brings the classic genre back to life.

Don’t forget, our Streamer Cash Contest is still live, with a huge $300 prize fund up for grabs! Everyone is welcome to join – find out all the details on our Discord!

notes.title: WILD WEST Major Update is LIVE + CASH CONTEST!
notes.notes:
As summer comes to a close, I’m thrilled to bring you another exciting update for Nuke Them All RTS!

What’s New?
New Wild West v2 Map!
Get ready to explore the fully reworked Wild West map in the Desert World! While the name might be familiar, this map has been completely overhauled with fresh challenges and environments. Head to Desert World and replay the second map—you won’t recognize it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148300/46289ce00fbed1a0bf77d09aa78d1048b8664b2c.jpg

Freeze Uplink Fully Reworked!
Winter is coming, and so is a powerful new Freeze super weapon! Drag & drop the reworked Freeze on your enemies and watch the magic unfold. Get ready to "Let it go!" in the most explosive way possible!

4 Brand New Cutscenes!
Enjoy four hilarious new cutscenes packed with dad jokes and puns—guaranteed to make you chuckle while you strategize.

30 New Voice Lines!
We’ve added 30 new voice lines featuring popular movie one-liners and beloved game references. Your units just got a lot more entertaining!

Improved Hedgehog Repair Vehicle & Quick Access Button!
Need to find your Hedgehog on the map quickly? Press H to locate it instantly. Plus, the repair vehicle’s functionality has been enhanced for better gameplay.

Enhanced Repair Hotkey!
Hit R to send your damaged vehicles to the repair bay. Don’t worry—they’ll return to their original spot once they’re fixed up and ready for action!

Improved Fatso Fortified Flag Upgrade Time!
We’ve tweaked the upgrade time to make your defenses even more formidable.

Grenade Launcher Rework!
Get ready to blast your enemies with the newly reworked grenade launcher, now better than ever!

Alien Beacon and Radar Added to "NUKE THE MALL" Map!
Take your strategy to the next level with the new Alien Beacon and Radar features added to the "NUKE THE MALL" map. More ways to dominate the battlefield!

DEMO - fully updated! Enjoy!

And Many More!
We’ve also made numerous small optimizations and bug fixes to improve your gameplay experience.

Enjoy these exciting new features and enhancements, and as always—Happy Nuking!

P.S. Don’t forget, our $300.00 Streamer Cash Contest is LIVE!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Unleash Chaos with New Units, Secret Map, and More!
notes.notes:
Major Update - New Units, New Alien Super Weapons & Croc Buffet New Map!
As we dive into the hot summer, I'm thrilled to bring you the super major update for Nuke Them All, packed with amazing new features, units, and a secret bonus map! Here’s all the cool stuff we’ve added:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148300/e41c385441c6bf8ae0d9e5dd45e69d3d44479cd9.jpg

New Units:
Enemy Rocketbot - Meet the powerhouse blue robot, usually perched on defensive towers! This enemy is a force to reckon with, so strategize wisely.

Reworked Enemy Jeep V3.0 - Now even more powerful, it comes loaded with a grenade launcher or a Rocketbot. Beware of this jeep, which appears late in the game after enemies upgrade their Vehicle Factories!

Fatso Truck - Introducing our new TIER 5 super vehicle! Now available in Vehicle Factory Level 5 and the Tech Tree, replacing the APC tactical vehicle.

New Bonus Map - Croc Buffet:
This secret bonus map is accessible only if you know where to look! Here’s a hint: try clicking the crocodile on the Jungle World selection screen and see what happens! It’s a brand-new map where robots can swim through the swamp, adding whole new gameplay elements. But beware of nasty surprises lurking in the water!

Reworks & Improvements:
Hellrain Targeting System - Fully reworked to use enemy super weapons smartly, automatically detecting weaknesses in your strategy. Watch out for the new Smart CPU AI!

Alien Allies SUPER WEAPON - Fully revamped! Instead of the old passive support of 3 UFOs, we now have a fully controllable super weapon delivered via the Alien Beacon. Once ready, drag and drop to target a position and watch the powerful Alien Mothership do the work for you!

New End-Level Fun Cutscene - Featuring the Fatsos, adding a fun twist to the conclusion of your battles!

3 New EPIC Background Music Tracks - Feel the 90s nostalgia with new music tracks that will enhance your gaming experience!

Balance Changes:
Bridges - Now have more health, making them harder to destroy.

Digger - Improved to be sneakier than ever!

Protected Flags - Upgrade faster, providing strategic advantages.

Crashes Fixed:
Resolved late-game rare crashes and freezes.

Fixed Start System and achievements.

In-game Wiki updated with new units and stats.

Happy Nuking!

P.S. Our $300 Streamer Cash Contest is LIVE! Everyone is invited; details are available as usual on Discord! https://discord.gg/6EMswKqpJh

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: New Units and Gameplay Features!
notes.notes:
Hey RTS Fans! Buckle up and get ready for an explosive update in "Nuke Them All!" We’re rolling out new units, gameplay features, and fixes to make your experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44148300/bbe80108d423a336b4399f2103bed74db1d2279b.jpg

New Unit: FATSO Robot
Meet FATSO, the heavyweight champ of the red team! Armed with a heavy machine gun or rocket launcher, FATSO is the slow-moving, hard-hitting new defender. He may move like a tortoise, but he hits like a tank. Just don’t get in his way, or you’ll find out why slow and steady wins the race!

Protected Flags
Elevate your strategic game with Protected Flags! Use the Hedgehog construction vehicle to build a defensive tower directly on the flag, creating fortified positions that will keep your enemies at bay. It's a game-changer that brings order to the chaos!

Upgrade Protected Flags
Capture tech labs, upgrade your forts, and take your defenses to the next level. You can now enhance Protected Flags by adding a powerful FATSO on top, turning your flag into an impenetrable fortress.

NUKE Missile Direct Control
Ever wanted to steer a nuke? Now you can! Press SPACE when the nuke is descending and take direct control, just like the SuperSheep in WORMS 3. Navigate with arrow keys, avoid enemy fire, and press SPACE again to unleash devastation at the perfect moment.

Helpful Tips and Elements
No more getting lost! New helpful elements and text tips have been added to assist you in quickly finding game elements and buildings. Your path to victory has never been clearer.

New Unit: DIGGER
The enemy’s secret weapon is here! The DIGGER can go underground and launch surprise attacks. It becomes operational in the late game on certain maps, so keep your eyes peeled and destroy it before it wreaks havoc on your base.

Headbot Rework
Now more versatile than ever, the Headbot can be equipped with a backpack that unloads into powerful artillery, providing extra firepower when you need it most.

New R Hotkey
Managing repairs just got easier! Select your damaged vehicles and tanks, hit R, and they’ll automatically head to the repair bay and return to their positions once fixed. No more manual labor for you!

Slow Repair for Robots & Turrets
Robots and turrets can now be slowly repaired at the repair bay. It’s not as fast as vehicle repairs, but it keeps your defenses up and running.

Map Editor Improved
We’ve enhanced the map editor with new tools and features. We’re excited to see the creative and strategic maps you’ll come up with. Bring your ideas to life and challenge your friends!

Bug Fixes and Improvements


 Fixed Star System Bug: No more missing stars in the Tech Upgrades Tree!
 Fixed Steam Achievements: All achievements should now be trackable and unlockable.
 Death Canyon Rework: Updated for the Tower Defense festival with new challenges.
 Performance Boosts: Enjoy faster game loading times and smoother gameplay.
 Visual Upgrades: Enhanced effects when upgrading forts and buildings.
 Unit and Enemy Reworks

Big Bertha: Our massive blue tank now boasts a secondary cannon for added destruction.
Enemy Fort: Enhanced defenses to make your conquests even more challenging.
New NPC: Dragon
Dragons have been added to some maps as helpful NPCs. They’ll provide support and add an extra layer of strategy to your battles.

Crystal Collection & Base Building
Collect crystals and build bases on select maps like Nuke the MALL and Dark Moon. Expand your empire and dominate the battlefield!

Map Updates

SPOOKY Map: Reworked and optimized, exclusively for zombie battles.
Sandbox Mode: Improved for a more seamless and creative experience.
New Unit: FATSO on the Party Truck
The party has arrived! FATSO now has a mobile version, combining a heavy machine gunner with a party truck that can unload into a machine gun turret.

Updated Demo
Our demo now includes all the new features, with 6 basic maps plus bonus maps. Perfect for newcomers to get a taste of the action!

P.S. New cash contest for streamers starts in a week! Stay tuned!

Jump back into the action and nuke 'em all!

Happy Nuking!

notes.title: Major Demo Update is LIVE ☢️
notes.notes:
🚀 To celebrate our participation in the Steam Next Fest February 2024, the new epic major Demo update is LIVE! Available for free for a limited time, enjoy and play now! 🎉 Catch us during the Steam Next Fest and watch our live streams together for exclusive insights and fun behind-the-scenes action! 🎥🕹️

✅ Experience the convenience of quick save and quick load straight from the pause menu (just hit Escape).
✅ No more worries if your level crashes – restart the game, and it'll ask if you want to load your last autosave.
✅ Need a fresh start on a level? Hit the restart level button in the pause menu.
✅ Explore the Bonus planets section and face the challenge of the mysterious Dark Moon.
✅ Hedgehog rework - Hedgehog has undergone a fantastic makeover! It now boasts an appealing and enjoyable appearance. Additionally, I've resolved the issue of accidental clicks, preventing any unintentional disassembly into a mine.
✅ Command Grunt minions with precision – now you can instruct them to go far away, whether it's a boss or not.
✅ Sparky and Electrobot just got a power boost! They freeze enemies on impact for a solid 10 seconds.
✅ Electrobot is now a rockstar at reaching areas blocked by rocks – he goes underground to get the job done.
✅ Dive into the ocean and encounter reworked and fixed fish – they might not do much, but they sure look amazing.
✅ Gatlings & Jeep guns are now destructible! Destroy them, and you might leave enemies powerless.
✅ Zombies got a makeover – extra animations, cleanup, and optimization for maximum brain-munching fun!
✅ Robots' walking style got an upgrade – they don't converge into one spot anymore and won't overlap on arrival. Smooth moves!
✅ Reworked Sandbox - now 2 times more area to play and experiment including 2 towers.
✅ New enemy cannon added - "One shot, one kill" cannon, watch out!
✅ Reworked "House of Dead" and "Desert's Heart" maps for a more immersive and challenging experience.
✅ Unlock amazing Steam achievements in the demo!
✅ General optimization and performance fixes to keep the gameplay as slick as ever. Get ready for a flawless gaming experience! 🎮✨☢️

notes.title: Unlock New Adventures in the Full Version!
notes.notes:
Coming soon - in FULL VERSION of the game!

Collect Crystals & Minerals 💎
Explore secret locations on the map to discover precious mineral crystals. Use the Hedgehog vehicle to efficiently collect these resources, allowing you to summon formidable interplanetary reinforcements, including mechanoids! Embark on a mission to find and gather the crystals – you're in for an exciting adventure!

Base building? Why not! ⚒
Use portable mobile facory vehicles on certain maps when available to get an ability to deploy and build your own factories. The factory must be deployed only near flags and not overlap with it or other factories to start construction!

.. and Space Shuttle 🌕
The Space Shuttle serves as our interplanetary transport, facilitating journeys to distant planets where we can establish our formidable base fort. Select a clear location on the map, free from structures, rocks, and other obstructions, to seamlessly deploy our fort. Take charge of your planetary conquest and establish a strategic stronghold in the chosen spot!

Please wishlist and lets make it happen!
